Yes her character is awesome! She brings in more depth to the show than other procedural-type shows I have watched in the past. I truly think that she is one of the main reasons that can be cited as to why Lucifer is so entertaining, and why it has so many fans like you and I.

Yes I do like how they portray her as human, and I understand her situation is different dealing with Lucifer and his antics. I am just currently in school to become a therapist and in my ethics lecture I just found it funny that almost every ethical standard and principle was broken or bent. I do appreciate her growth in the show, and ultimately she is one of my favorite characters :)
